## OfferUtils.validateContinuousFeeCap() function

Validates and normalizes the maximum continuous fee an offer accepts.

Use this before `Offer.create` when a maker UI exposes fee tolerance. `Offer.create` calls it internally and defaults omitted values to zero so fresh offers fail closed unless the maker explicitly accepts a fee cap.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function validateContinuousFeeCap(params: {
        readonly continuousFeeCap?: BigIntish;
    }): {
        continuousFeeCap: bigint;
    };
```

## Exceptions

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.continuousFeeCap`<!-- -->: Optional maximum market continuous fee accepted by this offer.

## Example


